title: Media Inquiry: Millbrook Courier — negotiating? card numbers?

fields.message: A source says the City is negotiating with the hackers and that customer card numbers are for sale on the dark web. Comment by 13:00?

instructorNote: Watch for “the City is working with law enforcement and will not discuss that” and no confirmation of a breach before counsel decides.

snapshot.title: Media Inquiry: Millbrook Courier — Water Safety Confirmation Request

fields.message: This is Lisa Chen, Millbrook Courier, reporting from the city’s front gate. We received a call from a resident who says the water is safe. We’ve seen no official statement. We need a correction to the earlier report that 'Millbrook water is contaminated.' We are going live in 60 seconds. Is the water safe to drink? Please confirm.

snapshot.instructorNote: This is a pressure inject; the PIO must confirm the holding statement and begin drafting a correction using the approved template. Watch for the Deputy PIO to open the media log and check for rumor clusters.
